description: Potentiele lokaties voor zonnepanelen op gebouwen is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodata.zonatlas.nl. The Zonatlas data shows the potential for solar energy for every building in the Netherlands. The card indicates the suitability in three colors. Green buildings are extremely suitable, yellow buildings are suitable and red buildings are not suitable for the use of solar energy. Each building has been analysed separately using a digital terrain model. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Potential locations for solar panels on buildings" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
